reason: The website https://gaspardamand.shop/ mimics the official Isabel Marant website but lacks transparency regarding its contact information and has potential security risks due to SSL certificate issues.
The website does not provide clear contact information such as a physical address or a detailed email address.
The claim of 'Paiement sécurisé par le protocole SSL' is contradicted by the SSL certificate issues encountered when accessing the contact page.
The website was registered recently (2025-07-14), which could indicate a short-term scam operation.
